sections.what_happened: NEW QUOTES TO THE RECORD (the interview is Tuesday night; the BBC relay of these lines is in-window): Trump, addressing reports Washington was considering strikes on parts of Iran, said 'We have to do something large,' adding the action could involve a 'heavy hit'; 'They will never have a nuclear weapon.' He also acknowledged rising petrol prices hurt Republicans in the midterms ('voters didn't like it when they had to pay more for fuel'). This is a threat-signal, NOT a strike decision: WSJ (via Gulf News 07:01 entry, already recorded) reports Trump has 'leaned toward' a large attack after the midterms but has NOT decided. PortWatch backbone: NO fresh counted transit figure exists -- newest snapshot portwatch-2026-10-26.json is STALE (latest observation 2026-10-18: Hormuz 4 transits that day, 7-day avg 3.7 vs 2025 baseline 85.5/day); cited here only as stale baseline context, never as a current figure. The IRGC four-tanker claim is already recorded (0900-02) and is NOT re-reported as new here; Reuters now also carries the IRGC claim (Nov 4) without independent verification.
sections.what_verified: 2 declared families relaying ONE interview: BBC (T2, reporting family per Gulf News attribution) + Gulf News (T3, liveblog carrier). This is one interview, not two independent confirmations -- the count satisfies the sig>=3 family gate formally but the single-interview caveat stands.
sections.what_disputed: STRONGEST COUNTERPOINT -- Trump's own contradictory line hours earlier: to the FT on Nov 3 he said the US has 'no plans to attack Iran in the near future,' 'I'm ready, we're ready... but there may be no reason for it' (stockbiz relay of FT, published 08:35 , pre-window; FT 'locked and loaded' line already in Gulf News 03:25 entry). On Fox itself he said on further strikes only 'we're going to take a look.' WSJ: decision NOT made. Three Trump lines now stand side by side: 'heavy hit' / 'no reason to go' / 'take a look' -- no decision can be claimed from any one of them.
sections.why_matters: Trump lost Congress, then threatened a 'HEAVY HIT' on Iran -- but hours earlier he told the FT there was 'no reason to go.' Which Trump is telling the truth? The three quotes, side by side.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW RELAY (Gulf News liveblog 10:13 ): Trump says US must do 'something large' against Iran, warns of a 'heavy hit' -- BBC-reported Fox News quotes

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump lost Congress, then threatened a 'HEAVY HIT' on Iran -- but hours earlier he told the FT there was 'no reason to go.' Which Trump is telling the truth? The three quotes, side by side. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 'Minor attack' vs 'this is war': commenters overwhelmingly reject Trump's 'not really war' framing of the Qeshm strike, while Trump now threatens 'something large' -- escalation or bluff after losing Congress?
